description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Splinter & Leo, adding {C}{C}.
When Splinter & Leo dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Splinter & Leo from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Splinter & Leo enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
